title: Forensic-Aware Continual Adaptation for Image Forgery Localization
abstract: arXiv:2609.38251v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid evolution of image manipulation techniques has raised growing public security concerns. Existing Image Forgery Localization (IFL) methods can accurately localize manipulated regions but are often unable to adapt to newly emerging forgeries. In real-world forensic scenarios, data typically arrive sequentially, yet continual model adaptation remains largely unexplored in IFL. To bridge this gap, we introduce the first continual learning framework for IFL and establish a comprehensive benchmark under two realistic data-evolution protocols: cross-dataset and cross-content continual learning. Evaluations of representative state-of-the-art IFL and continual learning methods reveal substantial performance degradation, highlighting two key challenges: (1) adaptively capturing intrinsic forensic traces from incoming data across unseen domains, and (2) preserving previously acquired forensic knowledge during sequential adaptation. translated_title: 面向图像伪造定位的取证感知持续适应方法
translated_abstract: 图像篡改技术的快速演进引发了日益增长的公共安全担忧。现有的图像伪造定位（IFL）方法能够准确定位被篡改的区域，但往往无法适应新出现的伪造手段。在真实的取证场景中，数据通常是按顺序到达的，然而持续模型适应在IFL领域仍基本未被探索。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了首个面向IFL的持续学习框架，并在两种现实的数据演进协议下建立了全面的基准：跨数据集持续学习和跨内容持续学习。对代表性的最先进IFL方法和持续学习方法的评估显示出显著的性能下降，突出了两个关键挑战：（1）从跨未见领域的传入数据中自适应地捕获内在取证痕迹，以及（2）在顺序适应过程中保留先前获得的取证知识。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个面向图像伪造定位的持续学习框架，在跨数据集和跨内容两种现实数据演进协议下建立了综合基准，并揭示了自适应捕获未见领域取证痕迹与保留历史取证知识两大关键挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first continual learning framework for image forgery localization, establishes a comprehensive benchmark under cross-dataset and cross-content data-evolution protocols, and highlights two key challenges: adaptively capturing forensic traces from unseen domains and preserving previously acquired forensic knowledge during sequential adaptation.
